recipes.notes: No cmake, autoconf or generated config: src/lib/config-win32.h is selected by ares_setup.h when WIN32 is defined and HAVE_CONFIG_H is not, and include/ares_build.h is authored (the mingw branch of ares_build.h.dist, whose __int64 ssize_t line precedes any mingw header; socklen_t is int, ssize_t is long long). All src/lib/*.c are compiled (the POSIX event backends compile out). Tags cares-1_26_0 to v1.30.0 share the flat src/lib layout; the two trailing pins are the first-parent pair of the CVE-2024-25629 merge (found card c-ares-read-line-embedded-nul-cve-2024-25629 in corpus/catalog), both between cares-1_26_0 and cares-1_27_0. Releases from v1.33.0 move sources into subdirectories and are not pinned.
